items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Arnold Bolden was a good drummer and a good salesman. He came in behind Lloyd Scott with Cecil Scott's orchestra, a very good drummer.

ctx.x: But Cuba Austin was the first one. Of course, Lloyd Scott, I can't forget him. He was a good drummer. He was a very good drummer, a good salesman. Arnold Bolden was a good drummer and a good salesman. He came in behind Lloyd Scott with Cecil Scott's orchestra, a very good drummer.
